xai_report.personalizedExplanation: Individualized Evaluation for Rameshwar Patel (58y, Male, Rampur PHC (Block B)): The XAI diagnostic pipeline reveals clinically significant Moderate Non-Proliferative Retinopathy (Grade 2.1). Driven by chronic hyperglycemia (215 mg/dL over 12 years) and elevated arterial pressure (142/88 mmHg), Grad-CAM highlights prominent pathological activations across two main quadrants. The superior-temporal arcade exhibits 15 microaneurysms alongside 6 flame and blot intraretinal hemorrhages. Hard lipid exudates have begun depositing within 1 disc diameter of the macular border, indicating progressive breakdown of the inner blood-retinal barrier.
